suggested_changes.reasoning: Reducing the dropout rate may help the model become more sensitive to the minority classes. A lower learning rate and more epochs will allow the model more time to learn from the imbalanced data. Increasing gamma and alpha in the FocalLoss will make the model pay more attention to hard, misclassified examples and the minority classes respectively. Threshold optimization based on recall will prioritize identifying positive samples, which is critical in this medical context. More aggressive data augmentation for the rare classes may help to balance the classes and provide more varied examples for the model to learn from.
